lines.zh: 我在浅水里爬得比你快。
lines.en: I crawl faster than you in shallows.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，就滑出去一段。
lines.en: One flick of my tail carries me on.

lines.zh: 这具身体很小，水托得住。
lines.en: This body is small; the water holds it.
I keep to your feet.

lines.zh: 湿地我走得稳，干地不行。
lines.en: Steady on wet ground, useless on dry.
I walk and flick my gills.
My body hugs the ground, cool.
I thread around every stone.

lines.zh: 这水不干净，我皱了下鳃。
lines.en: The water is foul; my gills pinch.

lines.zh: 我朝潮水退去的方向走。
lines.en: I head where the tide withdrew.
Slow, but I do not stop.
I burrow into mud and out again.
I know these waters well.
I stop to lick my claws.
Do not tread on me in the water.
I slide over stone, leaving a wet trace.
I keep half my face in the water.
My gills open and close, slowly.
This water has soured.
I am waiting for a drowned one.
The patterns on me are shifting.
I need little air.
I look up; light shivers on the water.
I used to leap from the water.
Now I only want to stay.
I tap the water with my tail.
This small body hungers easily.
I lie flat on a stone.
Weeds tangle around my feet.
I watch what moves below.
You smell of dead water.
I know your kind of living thing.
I am smaller, but not afraid.

lines.zh: 靴子一进水，你就追不上我。
lines.en: Once your boots fill, you cannot catch me.
One inch closer with that finger and I bite.
My blink always comes half a beat late.
I know this battlefield.
You cannot outrun me wet.

lines.zh: 我伏在水面下，看你的脚。
lines.en: I lie under the surface, watching your feet.
Have you killed a drowned one?
I curl into a crevice, gills still fanning.
Mud in my gills.

lines.zh: 我滑回水里，伤口凉下来。
lines.en: I slide back into the water and the wound cools.
A small piece of me came off.
I roll over, and back.
I bite my own tail.
This will heal quickly.
I cannot make a sound.
I tremble, but stay.
You hit hard.
Only what lives in water.
That is too dry.
I bite, to test it.
I prefer it raw.
Put it in the water first.

lines.zh: 晃来晃去，我可不会客气。
lines.en: Dangle it and I will not be gentle.
I swallowed it.
I want this.
I can smell rot.
Take it away. I am not hungry.

lines.zh: 我太小了，你根本感觉不到。
lines.en: Too small for you to feel me.
Do not rub me with your boot.
The shove rolls me over.
My body is very slick.
You collided with water.
I slip under a stone.
Stay back. You will crush me.

lines.zh: 我一扭身，从你脚趾间溜走。
lines.en: A twist, and I slip out between your toes.
My bones are soft. Do not press.
Too crowded. I yield.
Only in water do I speak of this.
Few of my kind remain.

lines.zh: 那些花纹是为了吸引人。
lines.en: Those patterns are meant to attract.
I flick my gills.
You have no gills. No.
I sink below.
This body has already changed.
Do not.
I turn my head away.
See me in the water.
One bite first, to see if it wriggles.

lines.zh: 我含在腮边，慢慢咽下去。
lines.en: I hold it by my gills and swallow it slowly.
I carry it back through the water.
I hide it under a stone.
This smells of dead water.
My feet are too soft to grip.
It took me a while.

lines.zh: 你拿走吧，水里我吃得饱。
lines.en: Take it; the water feeds me well enough.
I bite it. No taste.
I drag it to my nest.
You hit me.
Then I answer.
The light on me has changed.
The water will help me.
I am fixed on your ankle.
My gills flare.
Do not think me small.

lines.zh: 腮边新长的纹，记着你的样子。
lines.en: The new marks by my gills remember your shape.
I draw back to lunge.
Come.
I circle your feet.
I see clearly underwater.
You are all openings.
No hurry. The water favors me.
I moved when you turned.
I creep closer.
You stepped into mud.

lines.zh: 这里有我，就一定还有别人。
lines.en: Where I am, others follow.
My gills are twitching.
Do not retreat to the water.
My teeth close just above your boot.
I ram your calf.
My claws slide off your armor.
A small bite, but it stings.

lines.zh: 我沿泥面滑冲，一口咬实。
lines.en: I slide along the mud and bite down hard.
I bite from behind.
A lift of your foot avoids me.

lines.zh: 我挂在你裤脚上，不松口。
lines.en: I hang from your trouser leg and do not let go.
In water you would be finished.
One strike, then back.
I lift my head from the water.
These waters have turned.
I come along the current.

lines.zh: 我身上长了不该长的东西。
lines.en: Something grows on me that should not.
I land in the puddle at your feet.

lines.zh: 我记得自己原来是粉色的。
lines.en: I remember being pink.

lines.zh: 我没见过这么大的地方。
lines.en: I have never seen a place this big.
Water gathers toward me.
I shake my gills.
You smell of the drowned.
The water boils off; my skin burns.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，摔得发扁。
lines.en: I fall from height and land flattened.

lines.zh: 这里的水太深了，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Too deep — I cannot breathe.
The blast slaps me onto stone.
An arrow skewers my gill.
Magic scrambles my patterns.
Too hungry even to stir the water.
Lightning crosses the shallows, numbing my bones.
No water here. I will dry out.
